description: Erection of an additional storey to existing two storey office building with extension of existing external stairway for access
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The development shall not be implemented other than in full compliance with all recommendations and requirements contained within Energy Statement (ref. E843-ES-00) dated 29 January 2019 and by Doherty Energy.  The measures shall thereafter be retained as such.

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be implemented other than in full compliance with all recommendations and requirements contained within Noise Assessment Report (ref. TH211186NR) dated 29 January 2019 and by Peak Acoustics Ltd. The measures shall thereafter be retained as such.

Condition : 6 - The floorspace contained within the development hereby permitted shall not be used other than for the purposes specified on the plans hereby approved and ancillary to the main use of the premises and shall not be used for any other purpose.
